keyFindings.description: The daily-report instruction is now softer than the live proof that measures it. The skill reads 'under about 2,000 characters' while scripts/e2e/stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh:5461 asserts (.payload.body | length) <= 2000 with no margin, inside until_true 300 ... report_posted (:5463) whose timeout ends in fail (scripts/e2e/lib/rig.sh:79), and scripts/e2e/README.md:1452 documents the row as 'within 2,000 characters'. A controller that obeys the skill with a 2,050-character report makes the daily-report row burn 300 s and fail blaming a missing report rather than a long one. Before this change the two agreed exactly ('at most 2,000 characters' against <= 2000), so the mismatch is new with round 2's fix, not pre-existing. Requested fix: the instruction, to 'at most 2,000 characters', in skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md:341; the generated copy packages/claude-envoy/legion/skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md follows through scripts/build.ts. Loosening the assertion to a soft check instead was considered and rejected: the number exists because that proof measures it, and a soft check would stop proving the thing the row exists for. The file is at 498 lines, so the swap stays under pi-legion's 500-line guard. Raised by the architect from the tester's report, found independently by both halves of the thermonuclear pair at this head, and verified in the files by this review.

The generator now writes two tracked Go files (packages/contracts/scripts/gen-go.ts:437-452), but the registry that tells an agent which files are generated and must not be hand-edited still names one: ':13' ('Go output in packages/envoy/internal/contracts/generated.go'), ':22' ('compares a fresh render with the committed generated.go', singular), ':23' (the 'generated; do not hand-edit' table row) and ':112' ('Do not hand-edit packages/envoy/internal/contracts/generated.go.'). packages/daemon/internal/dispatch/generated.go is described only in the cap-specific row at ':32' and in packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:1828, and packages/daemon has no AGENTS.md. It fails closed - the file's own header says it is generated, and the path filter added at .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml:191 makes a hand-edit go red - so this is the lesser of the two requested changes: add the daemon file to ':23' and ':112' and make ':13'/':22' plural.

verified.notHeld: Three findings from the pair that this review does not hold. (1) The GEN_GO_CHECK_ROOT seam's shape (thermonuclear-code-quality, Medium): it fails closed - a root without the copies makes Bun.file(path).text() reject ENOENT at gen-go.ts:473 and the process exit non-zero - CI never sets the variable (check:go runs only in the envoy-go job), and the write path at :489-492 has no seam, so a regeneration can never be pointed away from the tracked files. A --out <root> parameter would be a better shape and is named in the review for a later pass, but nothing here is wrong or fails open. (2) The 'takes more once it is split' clause in for-agents.md:105-106 and packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md:424-425 (thermonuclear-deep-review, Minor): strictly read it is ambiguous, since no route removes a margin record (no DELETE comment route in routes_table.go:129-136; a resolve only flips resolved) so only the new document a split makes has room - but that is the server's own refusal wording at growth.go:201-203, which is what a caller reads when it meets the 413, and documentation that said something different would be worse. If the sentence is imprecise it is imprecise there, pre-existing and outside this issue. (3) The mixed overCapMessage/literal conventions now in dispatch-execute.test.ts and dispatch-images.test.ts: defensible, since the body-cap assertions must follow the constant and the ask-cap ones must not.
